participant_id.Description: Participant label. Study record identifiers were replaced by sequential labels.

in_analysis.Description: Whether the participant entered the analyses of the associated article.

retreat_days.Description: Days of meditation retreat reported at screening.

meditation_frequency.Description: Meditation sessions per week reported at screening.

meditation_length.Description: Typical length of a meditation session reported at screening, as the answer code of the screening form (2 to 5).

meditation_years_experience.Description: Years of meditation experience reported at screening.
